Matches Go: nil is empty, a JSON string is unquoted, and other JSON passes through as raw text. Covered by spec/webb_spec.cr (string, number, boolean, object, nil)

Matches Go: `--name`/`--role`/`--json`, `unknown flag` usage as `webb ax-find ...`, `No matching nodes` on stderr with exit 1, and `query failed: <cause>` on lookup failure. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (name, role, JSON, no match, unknown flag)

Matches Go: `--json` with any other argument positional, `usage: webb ax-node <selector> [--json]`, and `fatal(getAXNode error)` so a missing selector reports `element not found: <cause>` with exit 2. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (detail, JSON, usage, missing element)

Matches Go: `--depth N` (with `missing value for --depth` and `invalid depth: <cause>`), `--json`, `unknown flag` usage as `webb ax-tree ...`, and `failed to get accessibility tree: <cause>` on query failure. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (tree, JSON, invalid depth, unknown flag)

Matches Go: truthy and equality modes, `pass`/exit 0, `fail: got %q, expected %q`/exit 1, `--message`/`-m` wrapping, null/false/0/empty-string failures, usage fatal, and `JS error: <cause>` on eval errors. The dead `browser.close` in its ensure is gone (Go's withPage never closes; Crystal's exit skips ensure). Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr

Matches Go: usage fatal, any element-lookup error becomes `element not found: <cause>` (exit 2), a nil attribute becomes `attribute %q not found`, and a present attribute prints its value. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (success, missing element via ROD_TIMEOUT, missing attribute)

Matches Go: MustNavigateBack + MustWaitLoad through navigate_back/wait_load, and the resulting URL prints only when Info succeeds (main.go:571-579), so an info failure is silent + exit 0 instead of an unhandled exception. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (back from /second prints the root URL); the nil branch rides on .page_info?'s unit examples

Matches Go: usage fatal, `element not found: <cause>` for a failed lookup (main.go:784-787), then MustSelectAllText().MustInput("") and `Cleared`. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (a cleared field reads back empty, the usage line, and the missing selector exiting 2); the emptying only works with rod 35d540d, where select_all_text selects the field

Matches Go: Network.clearBrowserCache through Cdp::Network::ClearBrowserCache, fatals `clear cache failed: <cause>` (main.go:613-615), then prints `Browser cache cleared`. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (a live clear leaves the page usable); the fatal branch is not CLI-reachable and upstream has no test for it either

Matches Go: usage fatal, `element not found: <cause>` for a failed lookup (main.go:759-762), `click failed: <cause>` for a failed click (main.go:763-765), then the 100ms handler pause and `Clicked`. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (#topic click, the usage line, and a missing selector exiting 2 with Go's message)

Matches Go: `%v` connect fatal, `failed to list pages: <cause>`, `cannot close the last page` before the index parse, `invalid index: <cause>`, `page index %d out of range` (no range suffix), the len-2-then-0 active clamp, and an ignored saveState error (main.go:1334). A MustClose failure escapes like every other Go Must*. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (last page, last-page-before-parse, closing page 0 of two with the saved active index, out of range, non-numeric index, unreachable browser)

Mirrors Go: net.SplitHostPort-style validation (bracketed IPv6 accepted, extra colons and non-numeric ports rejected), /json/version fetch, connect check, and save errors all fatal with Go's messages. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr including a live connect
Matches Go: prints the match count (0 for a missing selector, exit 0) and fatals `query failed: <cause>` for a broken selector. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr

Matches Go: usage fatal, `element not found: <cause>` for a failed lookup (main.go:853-856), href before src with `element has no href or src attribute`, `failed to decode data URL: <cause>` on the data-URL branch (main.go:862-866), `download failed: <cause>` around the page-context fetch (main.go:880-883), `failed to decode response: <cause>` on the base64 payload (main.go:884-887), raw bytes to stdout for `-`, `infer_download_filename` when no file is given, and `failed to write file: <cause>` before `Saved <file> (<n> bytes)` (main.go:896-899), with the write cause as Go's *PathError text through Webb.go_path_error. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (stdout `-`, inferred testfile.txt with its 11 bytes, usage, missing selector via ROD_TIMEOUT, element without href/src, a 404 fetch, and an unwritable path pinned to `open no-such-dir/out.txt: no such file or directory`); retrieval parity lives in spec/webb_spec.cr `.download browser parity`

Matches Go: `true`+exit 0 / `false`+exit 1 for found and missing selectors (no wait, like go-rod's Has with NotFoundSleeper), and a broken selector fatals `query failed: <cause>` (exit 2). Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr

Matches Go: usage fatal, `element not found: <cause>` for a failed lookup (main.go:800-803), the `-` branch draining stdin into a prefixed temp file with `failed to read stdin:` / `failed to create temp file:` / `failed to write temp file:` fatals (main.go:805-818), the stat branch printing the *PathError text `stat <path>: no such file or directory` through Webb.go_path_error (main.go:819-825), `failed to set file: <cause>` (main.go:827-829), and `Set file: <arg>` echoing the argument even for `-`. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (relative-path upload read back from the page change handler, stdin bytes through the temp file, usage, missing selector via ROD_TIMEOUT, and Go's exact stat message) plus Webb.go_path_error unit examples; the read/create/write temp-file fatals need an injected IO failure and stay structural. Divergence: the path reaches Chrome through File.expand_path so relative paths work (plans/parity.md)

Matches Go: usage fatal, `element not found: <cause>` for a failed lookup (main.go:1039-1042), then MustFocus() through el.focus (a panic on failure, as upstream) and `Focused`. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (#search-form input focus, the usage line, and a missing selector exiting 2 with Go's message)

Matches Go: MustNavigateForward + MustWaitLoad through navigate_forward/wait_load, and the resulting URL prints only when Info succeeds (main.go:581-589), so an info failure is silent + exit 0 instead of an unhandled exception. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (back from /second then forward prints it again); the nil branch rides on .page_info?'s unit examples

Matches Go: without a selector it prints document.documentElement.outerHTML; with one it fatals `element not found: <cause>` (main.go:641-644) then `failed to get HTML: <cause>` (main.go:645-648). Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (document HTML, element outerHTML, and a missing selector exiting 2 with Go's message rather than an unhandled exception)

Matches Go: usage fatal, `element not found: <cause>` for a failed lookup (main.go:1026-1029), then MustHover() through el.hover (a panic on failure, as upstream) and `Hovered`. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (#topic hover, the usage line, and a missing selector exiting 2 with Go's message)

Matches Go: usage fatal, `element not found: <cause>` for a failed lookup (main.go:776-779), then MustSelectAllText().MustInput() through select_all_text + input, and `Typed: <text>` from the joined arguments. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (the typed line, the usage line, the missing selector exiting 2, and the field reading back the typed value after rod 35d540d)

Serves raw TCP on 127.0.0.1:<port> and dispatches CONNECT/plain requests like Go's handler (main.go:1909). Fatal listen error uses Go's `proxy listen failed: ...`. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr `CLI auth proxy`

Matches Go: the expression is wrapped as `() => { return (expr); }`, a failed evaluation fatals `JS error: <cause>` (main.go:722-728), and the value prints by JSON type through Webb.format_js_result. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (number, string, null, boolean and pretty object output, plus a throwing expression exiting 2 with Go's prefix instead of an unhandled exception)

Matches Go: same URL handling (`http://` for a schemeless host, `about:blank` when empty, wait_load only for a real URL), index lookup by target id with the Pages() error ignored like `pages, _ :=`, `%v` connect fatal, `failed to save state: <cause>`, and the `Opened [%d] %s` line only when Info succeeds. MustPage/MustWaitLoad failures escape as exceptions like every Go Must*. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (blank page, schemeless URL, new page becomes active, unreachable browser)
Go's structure: own load/connect/list, creates a page at the URL when none are open (saving active_page 0), otherwise navigates the active page. Both branches covered by spec/cli_spec.cr

Matches Go: optional file defaulting to `page.pdf`, `failed to generate PDF: <cause>` around PrintToPDF (main.go:691-695), a drain loop that breaks on any read error and keeps the partial buffer (main.go:696-705), and `failed to write PDF: <cause>` around the write before `Saved <file> (<n> bytes)` (main.go:706-708). The write cause is Go's *PathError text through Webb.go_path_error (`open <path>: no such file or directory`). Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (a live PDF whose size line matches File.size and whose first bytes are %PDF, plus an unwritable path exiting 2 with Go's exact message)

Matches Go: parses the index before loading state and fatals `invalid index: <cause>`, keeps `page index %d out of range (0-%d)`, fatals per step (`%v` for state/connect, `failed to list pages: <cause>`, `failed to save state: <cause>`), and prints the switch line only when Info succeeds. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (non-numeric index before any session, usage, out of range, switching 0 then 1 with the saved active page, and an unreachable browser)

Matches Go: `*` marks the active page, inactive lines keep Go's marker-plus-space prefix, a page whose Info fails prints `(unknown)` instead of aborting, the listing failure fatals `failed to list pages: <cause>`, and state/connect failures fatal with their own cause (the connect wrapper belongs to connectBrowser's row). Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (missing/corrupt state, stale connect, one page, active marker across two pages) and spec/webb_spec.cr (.format_page_list and .page_info? with stub pages)

Matches Go: --hard sends CDP Page.reload{ignoreCache:true} and fatals `reload failed: <cause>` (main.go:596-600); the plain branch is page.reload (MustReload), then wait_load and `Reloaded`. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (plain reload, and --hard really navigates, clearing a marker set before it); the fatal branch has no upstream test either

Matches Go: `missing value for <flag>` echoes the flag actually used, `invalid width/height` fatal on bad numerics (64-bit like Go's int), and viewport/screenshot/write failures fatal with Go's messages, the write cause as Go's *PathError text through Webb.go_path_error. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (a live screenshot, the flag and dimension errors, and an unwritable path pinned to `open no-such-dir/shot.png: no such file or directory`)
Crystal command implementation is present; compare CLI output and error paths with upstream

Matches Go: selector and value are quoted as JS literals (Go %q, Crystal to_json), `select failed: ...` covers eval errors, and the returned value prints without JSON quoting. Covered for quoted values and missing selectors by spec/cli_spec.cr
Matches Go: non-numeric seconds fatal with `invalid seconds: ...` and exit 2, and a negative duration sleeps for no time. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr

Matches Go end to end: flag validation, single-process launcher flags, live-session close, stale state left in place, `failed to save state`, and the two output lines. Divergence: Crystal accepts the advertised `--show` that upstream rejects (plans/parity.md). Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr start examples

Matches Go: any loadState error (missing or corrupt) prints `No active browser session` and exits 0 via Webb.load_state?, an unreachable browser prints `Browser not responding (PID N, state may be stale)` and exits 0, a listing failure degrades to Pages: 0, and the running session echoes the saved PID/URL, page count, active page, and `Current: <title> - <url>`. All four paths covered by spec/cli_spec.cr

Matches Go: no-session fatal from loadState, closes only a browser we launched (chrome_pid > 0), TERMs the PID when it cannot connect, TERMs the proxy helper, removes state, and always prints `Chrome stopped`. Covered for external, stale, and owned sessions by spec/cli_spec.cr

Matches Go: the element check fatals with `form not found: ...` and the selector is quoted as a JS literal. An eval failure surfaces as an unhandled exception, the same treatment every Go Must* call gets in this port

Matches Go: usage fatal without a selector, `element not found: <cause>` for a failed lookup (main.go:662-665), then `failed to get text: <cause>` for a failed read (main.go:666-669). Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (text of #topic, the usage line, and a missing selector exiting 2 with Go's message instead of an unhandled exception)

Matches Go: prints the active page title, and a page Info failure becomes `failed to get page info: <cause>` on stderr with exit 2 through Webb.page_info instead of an unhandled exception. Covered by spec/webb_spec.cr (.page_info live title and a Rod::Page stub whose info raises) and spec/cli_spec.cr (live title)

Matches Go: prints the active page URL, and a page Info failure becomes `failed to get page info: <cause>` on stderr with exit 2 through Webb.page_info instead of an unhandled exception. Covered by spec/webb_spec.cr (.page_info live title and a Rod::Page stub whose info raises) and spec/cli_spec.cr (live URL)

Matches Go: uses page.element like Go's Element, then prints `true`+exit 0 or `false`+exit 1; every lookup or visibility error becomes `false`+exit 1 rather than a fatal (main.go:808-830). Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr with a visible, a hidden, a missing, and a broken selector

Matches Go: usage fatal, `element not found: <cause>` for a failed lookup (main.go:1052-1055), then MustWaitVisible() through el.wait_visible (a panic on failure, as upstream) and `Element visible`. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (a /late-page element that is hidden for 2s: `visible` reads false first, `wait` blocks and prints the line, then `visible` reads true; the usage line; and a missing selector exiting 2 with Go's message)

Matches Go: no argument check (extra words are ignored), MustWaitIdle() through page.wait_idle(1.minute) — Go's WaitIdle(time.Minute), i.e. a window.requestIdleCallback promise with a one-minute timeout, not WaitRequestIdle — then `Network idle`; a failure escapes as an exception like every Go Must*. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (on /slow-page, whose requests stay in flight ~4s, the command returns in under 2s, proving it does not wait for the network, and an extra argument still exits 0 with the same line). The previous wait_request_idle(500ms) port blocked for the whole network burst (10.9s in the red run)

Matches Go: no argument check (extra words are ignored), MustWaitLoad() through page.wait_load (a panic on failure, as upstream), then `Page loaded`. Covered by spec/cli_spec.cr (the line at exit 0, and an extra argument still exiting 0 with the same line)

Calls page.wait_stable(1.second) like MustWaitStable() = WaitStable(time.Second); spec/cli_spec.cr asserts `DOM stable`, exit 0, a >=900ms floor, and a >=3.5s wait on a page polling a 2s route, so the request-idle branch is covered
